list.heading: My Games
list.emptyDescription: A team leader creates games from the team page.

endDialog.title: End this game?
endDialog.description: The game finishes for everyone and moves to the archive. Open reviews close with the votes cast so far, and a review with no votes counts as accepted. This cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this game?
deleteDialog.description: This will permanently delete the game, its team goal, its proposed resolutions, its bingo cards and related gameplay data. The team and its other games are not affected. This action cannot be undone.

leaveDialog.title: Leave this game?
leaveDialog.description: Your bingo card, your leaderboard entry and the resolutions written for you in this game will be deleted. The resolutions you wrote for other players stay on their cards. You cannot rejoin this game. If you are its only leader, promote another player on the team page first.

configDialog.title: Configure Game
configDialog.description: The game ends automatically after its last day. Without a date, it ends only when you end it.

proposeDialog.title: Propose Resolutions
proposeDialog.description: Create or update a resolution for each team member. You can do this at any time.

teamGoal.label: Team Goal:
teamGoal.target: Target: {count, plural, one {# repetition} other {# repetitions}}

cardsTab.notStartedDescription: The team leader will start the game once everyone has proposed resolutions for each other.
cardsTab.heading: Bingo Cards
